conviction_note: The Q3 release is not pre-released line by line, but on 21 Oct the company raised its FY26 revenue target to SEK 2.6-2.7bn after Q3 had closed. That puts implied Q3/H2 sales above ABG's stale 14 Oct estimate (Q3 SEK 580m, FY 2,599m). The stock rose 5.2% on the raise and gave it all back, so the revenue part is largely in the price. What stays open is the EBITA margin (ABG 7.3% adj.), the order number and cash flow (Q2 operating CF was -4.8m). The last three prints moved +9.7%, +6.8% and +9.4%, which argues for a full-size abs_move_pct. With the revenue line pre-released, the lean is only mild (p_up 57). The findings sum to +0.3 and the scaled number is +0.77: the cash-flow risk offsets most of the stale-bar finding, while p_up reflects that beats have been bought on this name.

already_public.what: FY2026 revenue target raised from SEK 2.3-2.5bn to SEK 2.6-2.7bn 'following an improvement in order intake'; other targets (EBITA margin >6%) unchanged. Inside information, published after Q3 closed. The stock rose +5.17% that day and has since faded back to ~72.

Acquisition of Bavaria Digital Technik GmbH from an insolvency administrator for EUR 5.3m (5.8x avg 2023-25 EBITDA, includes property worth EUR 3.7m), half financed by an acquisition loan of EUR 2.65m. Adds ~EUR 17m of annual revenue and is consolidated from 2 Nov, so it is a Q4 item.
Q2 2026: order intake 719.3 MSEK, sales 634.6, EBITA 40.9 (6.4%), operating CF -4.8. The CEO stated a new run-rate of 210-220 MSEK a month.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales. Implied by the raised target: H2 of SEK 1,301-1,401m less ~30m of BDT, i.e. roughly 630-680m for Q3, against ABG's stale 580m. Likely a headline beat against ABG, but known to anyone who did the arithmetic.
Q3 EBITA margin, the genuinely unknown line. ABG expects 7.3% adj. (Q2 6.4%, Q3'25 6.5% adj.). Operating leverage on higher sales leans up, but this is unknown.
Q3 order intake as a number. The company has already said orders improved, so likely strong (up).
Working-capital build on growth. Q2 operating CF was -4.8m, and peer Scanfil flagged working capital burdening cash flow in Q3. The risk is negative.
FY26 target was just raised (21 Oct). A further move is unlikely; a possible comment on BDT or 2027. Unknown, probably unchanged.

bar: ABG Sundal Collier (commissioned research, the only visible estimate), 14 Oct 2026: Q3 sales SEK 580m, adj. EBITA margin 7.3%, FY26 sales 2,599m at 6.8%. https://www.inderes.fi/sv/third-party-research/inission-the-power-recovery-continues-abg . It predates the 21 Oct target raise, and its segment figures (EMS 535m + Power 117m) do not sum to 580m, so the bar is single-source and internally inconsistent. Every finding that depends on it is capped small. Company statement: FY26 revenue 2.6-2.7bn, EBITA margin >6%.

findings.finding: The 21 Oct raise of the FY26 revenue target to SEK 2.6-2.7bn was made after Q3 had closed, and it implies Q3+Q4 sales of SEK 1,301-1,401m. The only visible estimate (ABG, 14 Oct, not updated since) has Q3 at 580m and FY at 2,599m, so the release will most likely print a headline sales and order beat against the stale bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last three reports (Q4'25 on 2026-02-20, Q1'26 on 05-07, Q2'26 on 08-26) moved +9.7%, +6.8% and +9.4% on beats against ABG. The 21 Oct target raise itself moved +5.2% and fully faded within a week.
findings.original_quote: Inission AB höjer omsättningsmålet för helåret 2026 från 2,3–2,5 miljarder SEK till 2,6–2,7 miljarder SEK till följd av en förbättrad orderingång. (Inission raises its FY2026 revenue target from SEK 2.3-2.5bn to SEK 2.6-2.7bn following improved order intake.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The stock rose 5.2% on 21 Oct and is back at ~72, where it traded before, so the market treated the raise as known. What is not visibly priced is that the published bar (ABG 580m) was never updated. If the market expected a large beat against it, the run-up would not be a flat +3.4% over 20 days and -0.8% over 5 days into the print. Shrunk because the revenue is effectively pre-released through the guide.
findings.independence: ABG's own 14 Oct note already argued for upside to the old guide (FY 2,599m, above 2,300-2,500): https://www.inderes.fi/sv/third-party-research/inission-the-power-recovery-continues-abg . Same direction, a different source.

findings.finding: Q2 operating cash flow was -4.8 MSEK (39.6) as working capital built on growth, and peer Scanfil's Q3 note flags that increasing working capital burdened cash flow. With sales stepping up again in Q3, a negative cash-flow line is the likeliest disappointment in an otherwise pre-signalled report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 printed -4.8m operating CF and the stock still rose 9.4%, because cash flow was looked through when EBITA beat.
findings.original_quote: Kassaflödet från löpande verksamhet uppgick till -4,8 MSEK (39,6) (Cash flow from operating activities amounted to -4.8 MSEK (39.6))
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody publishes a cash-flow estimate for this name. ABG's preview covers only sales and margin, so the line is unanchored. Shrunk because Q2 showed holders look through it when EBITA is strong.
findings.independence: Scanfil Q3 2026 Nordea comment: 'Increasing working capital' burdened cash flow; 'Availability of components is getting harder'. https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00F8459

findings.finding: Nordic EMS peer Scanfil reported Q3 2026 sales and adj. EBITA 2-3% above LSEG consensus, with 8.5% organic growth, defence at 11% of sales and FY guidance unchanged. That is a modestly positive read-through on demand for Inission's EMS business, whose strongest end-markets are also defence and data centres.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history for peer read-through on this name.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-23 (per search listing; the page shows no date, and its text refers to 'Defense sector has been 11% of net sales in 2026')
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy, and Inission's own raise already told the market more than the peer does, so it is small. It is filed because it is sourced and it bears on the print.

findings.finding: The BDT acquisition closed on 2 Nov: an EMS business bought from an insolvency estate at 5.8x EBITDA, including its EUR 3.7m property, half loan-financed (EUR 2.65m). The report will be the first chance for management to quantify accretion and any Q3 transaction costs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announcement day (15 Oct) closed -2.96%, which is not clearly attributable to the deal.
findings.original_quote: Köpeskillingen uppgår till 5,3 MEUR, motsvarande ett enterprise value (EV) om 5,8 gånger den genomsnittliga EBITDA för 2023–2025. Förvärvet finansieras genom ett förvärvslån om 2,65 MEUR. I förvärvet ingår BDT:s fastighet, till ett värde av 3,7 MEUR. (Purchase price EUR 5.3m, EV 5.8x average 2023-25 EBITDA; financed by a EUR 2.65m acquisition loan; includes the property worth EUR 3.7m.)
findings.why_not_priced: Public and small. The loan buys a cheap, asset-backed revenue add (~SEK 190m a year), not distress. The only thing not yet priced is management's framing of it in the report.

baseline_tension: Mild agreement. The lean (-0.17) and the flat run-up are essentially neutral, so the small positive lean neither fights nor follows them. With no short anchor (truncated zero), there is no positioning to beat.
language_note: Every primary document (invitation, target raise, BDT deal, Q2 report) was bilingual sv/en on the Nasdaq feed, so the filing carried nothing English sources lacked

Swedish press (EFN/Direkt, 21 Oct) added only the intraday reaction ('Inission steg med 4% vid börsöppningen') and an EFN buy-case column headline ('Het sektor, låg värdering – köpläge i Inission'), which suggests retail-facing sentiment is positive
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the stale-bar revenue finding was cut from +1.2 to +0.6, because the FY revenue was effectively pre-released through the 21 Oct raise. p_up moved from 60 to 57.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): the working-capital/cash-flow finding was enlarged from -0.6 to -0.8

'The move is in the guide': the guide was just raised and is not expected to move again, so abs_move_pct went from 6.0 to 5.5. It was not cut to 3, because the Q3 quarter itself (margin, orders, cash) is not pre-released and the last three prints moved 7-10%.
Truncated-zero rule: positioning_check states there is no anchor rather than 'nobody is short'
print_vs_bar_pct went from 6 to 5, because the bar is single-source and internally inconsistent (ABG's segment figures do not sum to its total)
